examples.text: These winds tend to drop moisture on the eastern sides of continents（continent的复数形式）, leaving their western sides drier.
examples.translation: 这些风往往把水汽释放在大陆的东侧，使西侧更加干燥。
examples.speechText: These winds tend to drop moisture on the eastern sides of continents, leaving their western sides drier.

examples.translation: 后来，意想不到的事情出现了。

examples.text: When the Egyptians adopted the seven-day week, they named the days after five planets, the sun and the moon.
examples.translation: 埃及人采用七天一周的制度时，用五颗行星、太阳和月亮为每一天命名。
examples.speechText: When the Egyptians adopted the seven-day week, they named the days after five planets, the sun and the moon.

examples.text: Some agricultural companies also ask powerful influencers to market their products（product的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 一些农业公司也会请有影响力的网络红人推销产品。
examples.speechText: Some agricultural companies also ask powerful influencers to market their products.

examples.text: At 15 vehicles（vehicle的复数形式） per mile per lane, one driver tapping the brakes can cause traffic jams.
examples.translation: 当每条车道每英里有十五辆车时，只要一名司机轻踩刹车，就可能造成交通堵塞。
examples.speechText: At 15 vehicles per mile per lane, one driver tapping the brakes can cause traffic jams.

examples.translation: 不要把关注点放在自己身上。

examples.text: We learn the grammar and vocabulary and even the correct pronunciation of the foreign people, but we may forget the important emotional effect of the music of our speech.
examples.translation: 我们学习语法、词汇，甚至外国人的正确发音，但可能忽略了语言音乐中重要的情感效果。
examples.speechText: We learn the grammar and vocabulary and even the correct pronunciation of the foreign people, but we may forget the important emotional effect of the music of our speech.

examples.text: Another change is in the relationship with teachers.
examples.translation: 另一个变化体现在与老师的关系上。
examples.speechText: Another change is in the relationship with teachers.

examples.text: I had dreamed（dream的过去分词形式） about it for years.
examples.translation: 多年来，我一直梦想着这件事。
examples.speechText: I had dreamed about it for years.

examples.text: Weiqi can teach concentration, balance and discipline.
examples.translation: 围棋能培养专注力、平衡意识和自律能力。
examples.speechText: Weiqi can teach concentration, balance and discipline.

examples.text: Look for other signs（sign的复数形式）.
Unlike forward walking, which primarily engages the ankles, backward walking shifts（shift的第三人称单数形式） the workload to the knees.
examples.translation: 和向前走不同，向前走主要用到脚踝，倒走会把受力转移到膝盖上。
examples.speechText: Unlike forward walking, which primarily engages the ankles, backward walking shifts the workload to the knees.

examples.text: What I was trying to do is to persuade my brother to give up smoking.
examples.translation: 我当时想做的是说服弟弟或哥哥戒烟。
examples.speechText: What I was trying to do is to persuade my brother to give up smoking.

examples.text: Police departments in many places have scaled down their traffic enforcement, Adkins says, and speeding and careless driving（drive的-ing形式） seem to be getting worse.
examples.translation: Adkins说，许多地方的警察部门减少了交通执法，超速和粗心驾驶似乎也越来越严重。
examples.speechText: Police departments in many places have scaled down their traffic enforcement, Adkins says, and speeding and careless driving seem to be getting worse.

examples.text: The welfare system will enable people to become rich.
examples.translation: 福利制度将使人们变得富有。
examples.speechText: The welfare system will enable people to become rich.
